channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: ‘It's awful’: How tariffs, soaring fuel costs and higher interest rates are squeezing American companies
item.description: Tariffs, fuel prices and interest rates are squeezing American companies, particularly manufacturers, auto suppliers, retailers and transportation businesses.

item.title: Bessent calls meeting with China Vice Premier He Lifeng 'successful' ahead of Trump-Xi summit
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said his meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng was "successful" ahead of the Sept. 24 Trump-Xi summit.

item.title: Oil falls as crude flows remain 'surprisingly strong'
item.description: Oil fell Monday, as traders keep watch for a recovery in shipments from Saudi Arabia, even as Mideast tensions continue to escalate.

item.title: Trump to meet with NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Monday ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The mayor's press office said the meeting will take place at Gracie Mansion and "will focus on issues affecting New York City and New Yorkers."

item.title: U.S. urges Americans to reconsider Middle East travel as Iran tensions rise
item.description: The State Department urged Americans to reconsider Middle East travel as Houthi attacks intensify and Iran keeps the Strait of Hormuz closed.
